task.question: Who is the President of Peru that was censured on January 9, 2026?
task.evidence: February 17 – President of Peru José Jerí is censured by the Congress of Peru, removing him from office. He is succeeded by José María Balcázar.

answer:
Based on the search results, I can see that José Jerí was the President of Peru who was censured (through a vote of no confidence). The Wikipedia article mentions his impeachment proceedings and that he was ultimately ousted by Congress.
